  1 // Package term is a terminal emulator without a terminal: a VT parser, a
  2 // screen and scrollback model, and an input encoder, in pure Go (the phase
  3 // 8 plan's C1 and D74). a3-app's terminal pane is remote: the bytes of a
  4 // pseudo-terminal on the agent's machine arrive over a WebSocket and go
  5 // into Write; the keys the user types come out of EncodeKey and go back.
  6 // rexui.Terminal draws a Terminal.

 23 //
 24 // # What it emulates
 25 //
 26 // xterm's common subset, as the programs of an agent's session use it
 27 // (vim, less, htop, git, tmux and Claude Code's TUI): the DEC/ANSI state
 28 // machine (Paul Williams' diagram), cursor movement and editing, scroll
 29 // regions, the alternate screen, tab stops, origin and wrap modes, SGR with
 30 // 16, 256 and 24-bit colour and underline styles, wide and combining
 31 // characters, OSC 0/2 titles, OSC 8 hyperlinks, OSC 52 clipboard writes
 32 // (handed to the app, which decides: TakeClipboard), bracketed paste, mouse
 33 // modes 1000, 1002 and 1006, application cursor and keypad keys, DECSCUSR
 34 // cursor shapes, and reflow on resize.
 35 //
 36 // # Memory and allocation
 37 //
 38 // Cells are 8 bytes and pointer-free; rows are offsets into a ring;
 39 // graphemes of more than one rune, styles and hyperlinks live in interned
 40 // side tables with budgets. Write allocates nothing per byte, and drawing
term/term.go                                                                      19,1            4%

313 func (t *Terminal) Damage() (lo, hi int, ok bool) { return 0, 0, false }
314
315 // ClearDamage marks every row drawn.
316 func (t *Terminal) ClearDamage() {}
317
318 // TakeReplies appends the bytes the terminal owes the program (answers to
319 // device attribute and status queries) to dst and forgets them; the app
320 // sends them as input.
321 func (t *Terminal) TakeReplies(dst []byte) []byte { return dst }
322
323 // TakeClipboard returns an OSC 52 clipboard write the program asked for
324 // since the last call (decoded from base64), for the app to allow or not.
325 func (t *Terminal) TakeClipboard(dst []byte) ([]byte, bool) { return dst, false }
326
327 // TakeBells is the number of bells since the last call.
328 func (t *Terminal) TakeBells() int { return 0 }
329
330 // AppendText appends the text between from and to (inclusive, in reading
331 // order), joining soft-wrapped lines and ending hard lines with "\n": a
332 // selection's copy.
333 func (t *Terminal) AppendText(dst []byte, from, to Pos) []byte { return dst }
334
335 // Find searches for needle (plain text) from pos, forward or backward
336 // through the screen and the scrollback, and returns the match's first and
337 // last cells.
338 func (t *Terminal) Find(needle []byte, from Pos, backward bool) (start, end Pos, ok bool) {
339         return Pos{}, Pos{}, false
